name: Election
overview: Scripture reveals that election is a sovereign act of God by which He chooses individuals and peoples for His purposes, as seen in His choosing Israel as a holy people (Deuteronomy 7:6) and calling rulers and apostles for specific roles (Nehemiah 11:1; Luke 6:13). The Messiah, Christ, is identified as God's elect servant, delighting His soul and empowered by the Spirit to bring justice (Isaiah 42:1). Election is also linked to God's foreknowledge and purpose, emphasizing that while many are called, only a chosen few respond in faith (Matthew 22:14; Isaiah 45:4).
